page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.24xlarge is a high-frequency compute instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It does not feature any integrated GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 48 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed applications. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

Given its high-frequency Intel Xeon processor and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfg9i.24xlarge offers high compute density. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions it as a general-purpose resource capable of handling compute-heavy tasks that also require moderate memory footprints. It is suitable for workloads such as high-performance web serving, application servers, build systems, and enterprise applications that benefit from high clock speeds without requiring massive memory arrays or local storage.
